input: Find a local tai chi instructor for beginners

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Tai Chi Instructor for Beginners
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a nearby tai chi instructor who teaches beginner-level classes.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or preferred area for finding a local instructor.

questions.title: Do you prefer group classes or one-on-one instruction?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants private lessons or is open to joining a group setting.

questions.title: Which days and times work best for your schedule?
questions.description: Determine the user's weekly availability to match with instructor or class schedules.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter out instructors or studios that exceed the user's budget.

questions.title: Is any specific style of tai chi important to you?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference for a particular style, such as Yang, Chen, or Wu.

questions.title: Are you looking for indoor classes, outdoor classes, or either?
questions.description: Clarify the user's setting preference, as some instructors teach in parks, studios, or community centers.

questions.title: What is your main goal for learning tai chi?
questions.description: Understand the user's primary motivation, such as stress relief, balance, fitness, or a health condition, to find the best-fit instructor.
